verdict.rationale: Poly offers its own programmatic surfaces: an official MCP server and a scriptable `poly` CLI. Through these, agents can search, read, create, update and organize files, copy and download into Poly, and read past revisions. But there is no public REST/OpenAPI API (all probe paths 404), and the MCP docs explicitly block some UI actions, such as permanently deleting from the Archive, so UI parity is contradicted rather than claimed. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose API, programmatic coverage of sharing/Shared Drives, rollback, Mind memory editing and view settings, any stated UI-parity guarantee, and allowing permanent delete over MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: MCP clients can connect to `https://mcp.poly.app/mcp` (streamable HTTP).
teaches an agent how to search, read, create, update, and organize your Poly files by composing poly commands.
cp — Copy between local disk and Poly, or within Poly ... wget — Download a URL straight into Poly
it lets you list any folder at any time in the past, as well as read files at a particular revision as they looked at that time.
Irreversible actions are blocked over MCP: rm archives files (reversible), and permanently deleting from the Archive is reserved for you
